data.title: Track Client Recovery & Progress | Help | TrainZilla
data.description: Review workout logs, meal swaps and recovery signals — sleep, HRV, RHR — in one dashboard, so you catch under-recovery before performance drops.
data.keywords: client progress tracking, recovery tracking software for personal trainers, overtraining warning signs, workout and diet logs, HRV guided training, coach dashboard

_rationale: This Help page currently describes only workout/diet logs and meal-swap tracking. Refreshed to fold in the recovery-signal dashboard view (sleep, HRV, RHR) that belongs on the same page, targeting this cycle's 'recovery tracking software' and 'overtraining warning signs' keywords without dropping the existing meal-swap coverage.
